svg.title: Zippy's Crown Quest — project card
svg.desc: Class 8 linear equations as a 25-minute voiced adventure: Zippy the monkey swaps crowns for gold bars on a balance. Tip it and Grumble wakes up. Built with Javascript, Web Audio, Pwa. Live demo. Banner: the game's real title screen.
svg.text: Class 8 linear equations as a 25-minute voiced adventure: Zippy the monkey
swaps crowns for gold bars on a balance. Tip it and Grumble wakes up.
